title: Strainers For Herbalism
intro: Strainers are simple yet essential tools used in herbalism to separate liquid from solid materials. They typically consist of a mesh or perforated surface attached to a handle, allowing for efficient filtration of herbal infusions, decoctions, and tinctures. In herbalism and home apothecaries, strainers play a crucial role in refining the quality of extracts by removing plant particles and impurities. Their use ensures that the final herbal preparations are clean, safe, and more easily absorbed by the body.
